upgrade.setup: Create a disposable home and Git project; install Claude Code only into the project.
upgrade.older_runtime: Replace that installed Claude scripts/ro.py with a script that exits unsuccessfully, simulating an unusable previous version.
upgrade.action: Install Codex only into the same project, then invoke the shared ro shim with --help.
upgrade.inspect: Read the shared shim and the project pre-push registration.

fallback.setup: Create another disposable home and project; install Claude Code globally, then Codex into the project.
fallback.action: Uninstall Codex from the project, then invoke the shared ro shim with --help.
fallback.inspect: Read the shared shim and confirm the global Claude runtime still exists.
